name: int2str
expr: sa = int2str(3.4); na = numel(sa); a1 = double(sa(1)); sc = int2str(-2.5); nc = numel(sc); c1 = double(sc(1)); c2 = double(sc(2)); sj = int2str(1e10); nj = numel(sj); j1 = double(sj(1)); sg = int2str(Inf); ng = numel(sg); g1 = double(sg(1)); sd = int2str(0.5); d1 = double(sd(1)); sz = int2str(3.6+1.2i); nz = numel(sz); z1 = double(sz(1)); sw = int2str(-3.2-4.8i); nw = numel(sw); w1 = double(sw(1)); w2 = double(sw(2));
comment: int2str scalar vs MATLAB R2025b. Implemented 2026-05-30 (was an undefined function). Rounds half away from zero (round) and renders a plain integer with no decimals/scientific notation; Inf/-Inf/NaN pass through. Fingerprints byte-compare the produced strings: int2str(3.4)='3' (na=1,a1=51='3'); int2str(-2.5)='-3' (nc=2,c1=45='-',c2=51='3'); int2str(1e10)='10000000000' (nj=11,j1=49='1'); int2str(Inf)='Inf' (ng=3,g1=73='I'); int2str(0.5)='1' (d1=49='1', half away from zero). DEEP-PROBE 2026-05-31: a complex SCALAR previously threw 'Cannot convert complex with nonzero imaginary part to double scalar'; MATLAB int2str operates on the REAL part (imag discarded): int2str(3.6+1.2i)='4' (nz=1,z1=52='4'); int2str(-3.2-4.8i)='-3' (nw=2,w1=45='-',w2=51='3'). namespace=builtin. Scalar only; vector/matrix column-alignment (and complex-array) is a separate deferred gap.
